theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_dtsr_dual_dist_count
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (a x : Euclid P) (b : Fin P → ℤ), (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => |x i - b i - a i| < infDist x {w : Euclid P | ∃ s : Finset (Fin P), m + 2 ≤ s.card ∧ ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ z : ℤ, w i - a i = z} / Real.sqrt (m + 2))).card ≤ m + 1
